title: Run mutation suites from the configured project root
after: Run every worker at that prefix
evidence: Actual nested repositories now pass with one and two workers, including dirty parent inputs, deletions and untracked files. Root mutation integration:86 passed.

title: Keep generic types out of comparison mutation
before: Syntax error counts as a kill
evidence: A parser-only TypeScript runner previously killed 4 invalid mutants without assertions. Independent replay now produces no type-only mutants for TypeScript, C++, Rust or Java.

title: Preserve the configured Windows command
after: Escaped percent transport for ordinary args
Protected delayed transport for multiline args
Original shell text and argv preserved
evidence: Real cmd.exe tests cover static variables, bang paths, pipes, chained commands, metacharacters and distinct empty-list/empty-string cases. Multiline arguments combined with static percent expansion explicitly refuse.

title: Admit scope identity and configuration values once
evidence: Actual coverage returned A+ for a strict scope after a second scope reused its name with target 100 and coverage exemption. Quoted false also became true. Admission now rejects both before scoring.

title: Emit the same Unicode paths the Action consumes
evidence: Temporary Git repositories reproduce and verify café.py and 世界.py paths, independent of the user's core.quotePath setting.

title: Use the named repository throughout release verification
before: Git and GitHub use caller directory
after: File, Git and GitHub reads agree
evidence: A target tagged v9.9.0 previously reported the caller's v1.0.0 tag. The regression now verifies both the target tag and GitHub command cwd.

title: Diagnose malformed installed hooks at their reader
evidence: Six malformed hook structures failed first. The complete doctor-plugin family now passes 43 checks, including valid and missing installations.

title: Preserve distinct functions that start on the same line
before: Rows keyed by name and line
Queue, marks and packets select the wrong function
after: Rows carry occurrence through SQLite and exports
Canonical keys and printed handles use complete positions
evidence: Real TypeScript callbacks retain distinct occurrences through exports and stored rows. Queue claims, brief, release and hook tests preserve those identities. Measured functions sharing an identical line span refuse separately; numeric selectors list distinct handles. Old exports remain readable with occurrence 0.

title: Require proof before reusing legacy debt identities
after: Separate metric and key format versions
Check current and historical collision groups
Refuse uncertain mapping before writing marks or audit records
evidence: CLI seed, rescore, verify and staged hook regressions preserve mark bytes on refusal. Override checks identity before recording any grant. Legacy claims reserve their entire raw-name group. Migration requires reviewing old source and carrying only approved values. Reader-version admission also refuses anonymous marks from pre-10 or unproved JavaScript-family analysis, even without a same-start collision; old-snapshot claims hold the entire raw-name group.

title: Parse expression arrows at their actual source spans
before: Functions disappear or inherit a sibling body
Identity and complexity use the wrong records
after: Commas close the correct arrow body
Unresolved TypeScript angle syntax refuses with a remedy
evidence: 39 targeted tests and the upstream JavaScript, TypeScript and TSX fixtures exercise extraction. Analysis version 10 invalidates old metric evidence. Parenthesizing an ambiguous expression or using a block body resolves the documented TypeScript limit.

title: Refuse coverage that cannot distinguish sibling functions
before: Distinct functions share one line span
Coverage projection contains no column identity
evidence: A real CLI regression prevents a false passing score. Equal hits, different hits and a single matching coverage candidate all refuse. Copies across scopes and unmeasured or complexity-only rows preserve their existing behavior.

title: Use complete identities in reports and duplication results
before: Numeric report links select ambiguous lines
Nested same-start functions compare equal to themselves
after: Read all positions once per file
Publish exact handles and occurrence fields
Compare complete identities when excluding self matches
evidence: Report commands survive actual PowerShell special characters. Packets and rescore output distinguish same-line siblings. The actual nested TypeScript duplication test retains the contained child as a twin.

title: Apply identity admission to explain and edit advice
before: Explain and edit advisory read raw marks
Another caller attaches an old exemption to a new function
after: Explain supplies full file positions and store history
Advisory checks the edited file's current records
Unproved advisory marks grant no exemption
evidence: Five public seam regressions cover the missed readers. The advisory opens no snapshot store and writes no key marker. Advisory and explain integration passed 53 tests with two opt-in latency checks skipped.

title: Give a root scope ownership of loose repository files
before: Loose source files disappear from inventory
after: Normalize dot to the root prefix
Inventory and coverage include root files
evidence: 25 ownership and CLI checks verify the root case, nested overrides and existing patterns. The configuration reference now states the actual root ownership rule.

title: Publish churn cache bytes under their own identity
before: Concurrent builders share a temporary path
One operation reads another operation's bytes
A cache entry carries the wrong key and data
after: Each operation owns a temporary file
Atomic replacement publishes one complete entry
evidence: Publication regressions force interleaving and confirm the returned cache belongs to the requesting operation. Invalid or interrupted cache writes remain disposable misses.

title: Keep ratchet history values and audit keys exact
before: Override audit names a raw function instead of its canonical key
after: History updates values while preserving entry age
Override audit records the exact admitted key
evidence: Temporary committed histories cover changes, comment-only commits and literal path headers. Finite admission and duplicate-name override regressions preserve the values and identities actually approved.

title: Frame the doctor interpreter probe and control its encoding
before: Startup stderr joins a version response
Windows encoding differs from the decoder
Doctor reports a foreign or damaged interpreter path
after: Bounded process owner captures and cleans up the child tree
evidence: A real startup warning and a real virtual environment under Jose with an accented e reproduced both defects. The replay confirms exact interpreter paths and ignores startup warnings when decoding the framed response.

title: Include typed reader mode in analysis-cache identity
before: JSX and TSX share one reader class
Warm JSX records bypass a cold TSX refusal
after: One predicate owns typed syntax mode
evidence: The public cold/warm replay accepts JSX, refuses cold TSX, and formerly accepted warm TSX. The paired admission tests now refuse both TSX paths. The shared 307-test green run also preserves same-mode rename hits.

title: Reject nonfinite coverage numbers before scoring
before: Default JSON decoder accepts NaN and Infinity
after: All coverage projections reject nonfinite numbers
Finite values and byte digests stay unchanged
evidence: Read-to-score tests reproduce NaN, Infinity, -Infinity and exponent overflow. Coverage, missing-line and selected-context projections refuse at admission. The shared admission batch went from 37 failures and one pass to 307 passing checks.

title: Retain evidence of historical identity collisions
before: Pruning removes the only collision witness
The same seed silently changes ordinal meaning
after: Store selects one recent witness per group
evidence: Public CLI regressions preserve collision evidence through repeated pruning. Red retention tests are paired with 19 current-root/retention checks and 59 affected e2e passes. One retained run can witness several groups; keep count remains a floor.

title: Limit pruning to the history it actually inspected
before: Another process records a new run
after: Later coverage and failed-verify runs survive
evidence: A real second Python process writes coverage or a failed verify between history selection and deletion. Both cases now survive. The fix adds no long write lock and does not claim to serialize updates to older runs.

title: Preserve mark and claim ownership across reader upgrades
before: Reader 10 recovers a callback at line 3
Old ordinal 2 attaches to the recovered sibling
after: Unproved anonymous marks refuse before writes
Unproved claims reserve their raw-name group
evidence: Seed, old-snapshot seed, direct override and claim regressions preserve bytes and ownership without remapping debt. The repair passed 196 focused checks; all 13 new cases plus the competition test passed. An older e2e fixture failed on message precedence; its current-proof rerun passed all three cases. Named marks and other languages keep compatible reseed behavior.
